expected.title: Hypoelliptic weak Poincaré inequality with arbitrarily small L2 error for nonnegative zero-source kinetic Fokker–Planck subsolutions
expected.author: Jessica Guerand; Clément Mouhot
expected.difficulty_reason: A usual Poincare inequality in velocity does not connect the separated kinetic cylinders or control position oscillations at merely measurable diffusion regularity. The Proposition13 proof constructs a four-part kinetic trajectory and uses fractional spatial regularization to make its position leg meaningful. A nonsingular position/velocity change then permits the distributional integration by parts and closes the adjustable L2 error; these nonroutine steps remain after standard energy foundations are allowed.
